$philosophy.PARTY_MODEL: ALL users are auto-connected on registration — everyone is linked to everyone. Like a party, everyone is reachable.
$philosophy.NO_SELECTIVE_FOLLOW: There is NO follow/unfollow mechanism. No selective connections. Auto-connect only.
$philosophy.NO_FRIENDS_HIERARCHY: No friends list, no followers hierarchy, no following hierarchy. Everyone = connected.
$philosophy.NO_EGO_COUNTERS: No followers count, no following count, no friend counts displayed as status. AGAINST numbers ego and status.
$philosophy.WOW_NOT_LIKE: Reactions use WOW (fire, clap, etc.) instead of likes. No like buttons, no like counts as vanity metric.
$philosophy.SHARE_YES: Sharing content is allowed and encouraged.

$header.IMPORTANT_runtime_alignment: MANDATORY: EVERY platform update MUST keep apollo-runtime aligned with all active plugins/contracts.
$header.CRITICAL_apollo_core_centralization: MANDATORY: ALL meta keys, CPTs, and taxonomies MUST be registered EXCLUSIVELY through apollo-core. NO direct register_post_meta/register_post_type/register_taxonomy calls anywhere else. apollo-core owns MASTER_REGISTRY + GLOBAL BRIDGE pattern.

$apollo_rule.MANDATORY: This section defines the single source of truth architecture for ALL Apollo development.

data_flow.php_array_object: Source of truth — all data originates from PHP backend
data_flow.rendered_html: Only user-facing content — never stores truth in DOM
data_flow.data_attributes: Only interaction hooks (data-a-*) — never hidden DOM truth
data_flow.debug_helper: Server log or admin-only debug panel — never client-side in production
data_flow.production: No debug output, no helper attributes, no console.log
data_flow.secure_db_data: Injected only in PHP before render, never as hidden DOM truth

mandatory_architecture: apollo_get_profile_context($user_id) — single source of truth for profile data
Render profile from that array — no scattered inline DB reads
Optionally pass a minimal JS config with wp_json_encode()
Keep helper tooltip/debug matching in WP_DEBUG only

nav_header_v6.DESCRIPTION: Apollo Nav v6 — Luxury Minimalist Header. Source of truth: _library/_dev working/_current/header.html
nav_header_v6.STATUS: DOCUMENTED — 13 PHP template part comment blocks embedded in header.html
nav_header_v6.php_conversion_notes: header.html contains extreme inline PHP conversion comments. Any dev can convert to template parts without prior Apollo knowledge.
nav_header_v6.load_order: data.php MUST be first script after <body> — engine.php depends on window.ApolloNavData

template_parts.content: <head> contents: meta, CDN core.js (wp_enqueue_script blocking fetchpriority=high), CORS shield inline, CSS (extract to nav-v6.css)
div#aprio-overlay + div.aprio-header-blur — zero PHP vars, static. JS controls via .on class.
Inline <script> motor JS dev-verbose: Panel, DM (KEY=apollo-dark-mode), Clock, BurgerArrow, Nav, Renderer, Morphism, NavFX, LazyList, boot()
template_parts.CRITICAL: Use nav-engine.php in SCRIPT_DEBUG mode, engine.php in production. NEVER both simultaneously.

template_parts.content: <nav#pn-nav> burger slide-in panel. #nav-list is EMPTY in PHP — JS injectAsideToBurger() clones from <aside> on open. DO NOT populate server-side.
div#pn-act — messages (#msg-list) + notifications (#notif-list). Both empty in PHP, populated by LazyList JS from ApolloNavData.
div#pn-apps bento grid. #bento-apps empty in PHP, populated by Renderer.renderApps() from ApolloNavData.APPS[].
div#pn-pf user profile panel. #pf-hero + #pf-menu empty in PHP, populated by Renderer.renderProfile() from ApolloNavData.PROFILE.
<header.tb> full top bar. Dynamic: avatar URL, unread badge .dot.on, clock #agoraH (live via JS Clock).
<aside.da> SOURCE OF TRUTH for sidebar nav. JS injectAsideToBurger() clones its <li> items to burger panel. Populate from WP nav menu registered as 'apollo-sidebar'.
template_parts.current_class: .ni.on — can be pre-set server-side for active page
template_parts.nav_anchor_class: .na — MANDATORY on every <a>, JS event delegates on this class

template_parts.content: <main#main-content> + div.cg#cards-grid. Cards grid empty in PHP, populated by Renderer.renderCards() from ApolloNavData.CARDS[].
MOST CRITICAL part. Defines window.ApolloNavData={APPS,PROFILE,CARDS,MESSAGES,NOTIFICATIONS}. MUST be first script in <body>. All arrays built server-side via apply_filters.
template_parts.SECURITY: ALWAYS wp_json_encode() — NEVER raw json_encode(). Sanitize all values before including in array.

template_parts.content: Production-minified boot engine. Same modules as nav-engine.php but compact. Use: SCRIPT_DEBUG=false → engine.php, SCRIPT_DEBUG=true → nav-engine.php. NEVER both simultaneously.
Lazy-load patch: hydrates #msg-list and #notif-list, injects NavFX wave picker. Uses MutationObserver with disconnect() after success. Can use defer.
template_parts.future: Replace ApolloNavData.MESSAGES with REST fetch to apollo/v1/chat/threads using X-WP-Nonce header

template_parts.content: GSAP bundle (async, fetchpriority=high) + morphism.js (defer). Must enqueue via wp_enqueue_script — NOT inline — to prevent duplication across plugins.

js_data_contract.PROFILE: Object|null — {name, role, avatar, menu[]}. null when logged out.
js_data_contract.MESSAGES: Array — {unread:bool, avatar, name, text, time}. Consumed in batches of 10 by LazyList.
js_data_contract.NOTIFICATIONS: Array — {type:'alert'|'highlight'|'info', isNew:bool, icon, iconColor, text, cta, time}. Batches of 10.

js_modules_map.DM: Dark mode. KEY must be 'apollo-dark-mode'. Syncs with script.js DM_KEY.
js_modules_map.Panel: Master panel manager for all .pn elements + overlay #ov.
js_modules_map.injectAsideToBurger: Clones <aside> li items into #nav-list with animation classes.
js_modules_map.Nav: Marks .ni.on on anchor click, closes panel on mobile.
js_modules_map.Renderer: renderApps(), renderProfile(), renderCards() — all from ApolloNavData.
js_modules_map.Morphism: Lazy init of window.ApolloMorphism SVG icon system, retries 12×.
js_modules_map.NavFX: _observer stored in NavFX._observer, disconnected on beforeunload.
js_modules_map.LazyList: Infinite scroll for msgs and notifs. Ghost card triggers load-more.
js_modules_map.boot: DOMContentLoaded entry point. Calls all .init() methods.

nav_header_v6.FORBIDDEN_dark_mode_key: apollo-dm — DO NOT USE. Diverges from script.js DM_KEY='apollo-dark-mode'.
nav_header_v6.icon_system: icon.v1.0.3.min.js — translates ri-* classes to inline SVG. DO NOT load remixicon.css alongside — causes icon duplication (font glyph + SVG rendered simultaneously).
nav_header_v6.FORBIDDEN_remixicon_css: NEVER load remixicon@4.x CSS font when icon.js is active. Root cause of icon duplication bug.
nav_header_v6.cors_shield: Use capture-phase addEventListener('error') for resource load failures only. NEVER window.onerror with broad apollo.rio.br domain suppression — hides real JS bugs.
nav_header_v6.script_src_inline_rule: A <script> tag with src= attribute IGNORES all inline content per HTML spec. Nav engine MUST be pure inline <script> without src=.
nav_header_v6.observer_rule: ALL MutationObserver instances MUST store reference and call .disconnect() on beforeunload with {once:true}.
